board: SparkFun Real Time Clock Module - RV-8803 (Qwiic), BOB-16281
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator rollover test into 2030, DRC-clean board). Modelled as an i2c-device rtc at 0x00 (DS1307 order) at address 0x32. The driver follows App. Manual 4.12/4.13 (re-read at 59 s, RESET-bit time set, one-hot weekday write, V2F/V1F clear). The sim's weekday register is not one-hot, so the driver works the weekday out from the date, which gives the same result on real hardware.
breakoutPinoutSource: SparkFun Eagle board file (github.com/sparkfun/SparkFun_Real_Time_Clock_Module_RV-8803, Hardware/Qwiic_RTC_RV8803.brd): J3 1x08 pads 1-8 = GND, 3.3V, SDA, SCL, !EVI, !INT, CLKOUT, CLKOE with silk labels GND 3V3 SDA SCL EVI INT CLKOUT CLKOE
